mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2% year-over-year indicates inflationary pressure, which typically leads to monetary tightening by the Federal Reserve, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances where CPIAUCSL YoY > 2%.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5 percentage points in one month signals economic weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where UNRATE rises > 0.5pp in 1 month.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in real GDP (GDPC1) for two consecutive quarters indicates a recessionary environment, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances where GDPC1 declines for 2 consecutive quarters.

mechanism_narrative: A significant drop in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 2% month-over-month signals supply chain disruptions, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where INDPRO drops > 2% MoM.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 4% and the unemployment rate (UNRATE) is below 4%, the tight labor market and high interest rates create a scenario where the S&P 500 forward returns are likely to be negative over the next 20 trading days.
regime_hint: tight monetary policy with low unemployment
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances where FEDFUNDS > 4% and UNRATE < 4%.

mechanism_narrative: A steady increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) indicates a strong labor market, which is typically associated with positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are negative in more than 40% of instances where PAYEMS increases.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in housing starts (HOUST) by more than 10% month-over-month signals a weakening demand in the housing market, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where HOUST drops > 10% MoM.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is below 2% and the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) is above 2% year-over-year, the combination of low interest rates and inflationary pressure is likely to lead to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
regime_hint: inflationary pressure with low interest rates
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are negative in more than 50% of instances where FEDFUNDS < 2% and CPIAUCSL YoY > 2%.
